title: More than a trading journal
author: Naive_Barracuda2069
selftext:
**Found a trading journal that’s actually doing more than just logging trades**

I’ve been checking out **TradeDNA**, and honestly, it’s a pretty interesting tool for anyone serious about improving their trading. It’s basically **a trading journal + AI trading coach + market intelligence tool** all in one.



A few features that stood out to me:

**AI Coach (Helix)** — analyzes your actual trades, journal entries, and history to help identify patterns, strengths, and recurring mistakes.

**Psychology tracking** — you can track things like stress, focus, mood, and sleep alongside your trades to see how your mental/physical state connects to your performance.

**Live market/news context** — see the news, economic events, and market data surrounding your trades.

**Market Rewind** — click on a candle and see what was happening in the market at that exact moment, including news and your trade/journal data.

**Chart analysis** — upload a chart and Helix can analyze the structure, levels, risk/reward, and compare the setup against your trading plan.

**Broker/platform integrations** — works with platforms like MT5, TradingView, Robinhood, Webull, Fidelity, IBKR, Coinbase, Tradovate, Topstep and more.

What I like most is that it’s not just telling you *“journal your trades and manage your emotions.”* It actually uses **your own trading history** to help you understand what you’re doing repeatedly.

If you’re already journaling, I think this is worth checking out.



There's a  **7-day free trial** too, so you can see if it fits your style before committing. **Message me for the code or if you have any questions!**
